uhc.text: Cataract surgery with lens implant prices for UnitedHealthcare commercial plans range from $1,839 to $11,210. The highest price is 6.1 times the lowest price, and most prices fall between $2,893 and $4,823.

bcbs_az.text: Cataract surgery with lens implant prices for Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona commercial plans range from $1,651 to $11,675. The highest price is 7.1 times the lowest price. Most prices fall between $2,376 and $6,785.

aetna.text: Cataract surgery with lens implant for Aetna commercial plans has a price range from $2,882 to $6,437. The highest price is 2.2 times the lowest price. Most prices fall between $3,506 and $5,020.

cigna.text: Cataract surgery with lens implant for Cigna commercial (employer or individual) plans had a lowest price of $2,938 and a highest price of $12,225. Most prices fall between $3,374 and $8,055, while the highest price is 4.2 times the lowest.
